meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把回复改成先给下一步动作、分步编号并标出耗时
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果读完长回复容易走神、总想知道下一步到底做什么。
copy.tagline_en: Turn replies into next-action-first, numbered steps with time estimates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long replies make you lose focus and you want the next step up front

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 的回复会按 ADHD 读者的需要改写:第一行直接给可以立刻做的动作,多步任务编成编号清单,每轮复述当前进度,给出具体时间估计,并把已完成的事讲清楚。开关一次后持续生效。
howto.when: 每次回复任意消息时都会生效,包括写代码、调试、解释、计划和闲聊,哪怕你没要求简短。输入 /i-have-adhd 开启,说 “stop adhd mode” 关闭。

say.note: 开启 ADHD 输出模式,之后的回复都按这套格式。

say.text: 我的登录测试挂了,直接告诉我下一步跑什么命令
say.note: 第一行是可执行动作,结尾留一个两分钟内能做的事。
关闭该模式,恢复普通输出。

howto.what_en: Claude's replies are shaped for an ADHD reader: the first line is the action you can take, multi-step work is numbered, state is restated each turn, time estimates are concrete, and finished work is shown plainly. It stays on once turned on.
howto.when_en: Applies to every reply, including coding, debugging, explanations, planning and casual chat, even when you did not ask for brevity. Run /i-have-adhd to turn it on; say "stop adhd mode" to turn it off.

say_en.note: Turns on ADHD output mode for later replies.

say_en.text: My login test fails — just tell me the next command to run.
say_en.note: Reply leads with the action and ends with one small next step.
Turns the mode off and returns to normal output.
